Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Maintaining an accurate 'Service Book' for every government school teacher is a mandatory managerial function.
Reason (R): The Service Book serves as the definitive record of a teacher’s entire career, detailing increments, leave accounts, and promotions, which are essential for pension calculation.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and (R) provides the correct explanation of (A). Under civil service regulations and statutory financial rules (such as Supplementary Rules SR 196–205), maintaining an accurate, updated, and verified Service Book for every government employee is a non-delegable managerial obligation of the Head of Office. The Service Book chronicles the complete official career of the employee, documenting appointments, grade pay fixations, annual increments, leave balances, transfers, and promotions. Because these verified administrative entries form the statutory evidentiary basis for calculating pension, gratuity, and terminal retirement benefits, maintaining it flawlessly is imperative.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है। केंद्रीय सिविल सेवा (सीसीएस) और पूरक नियमों (SR 196-205) के तहत प्रत्येक सरकारी कर्मचारी के सेवा में प्रवेश से लेकर सेवानिवृत्ति तक सेवा पुस्तिका (सर्विस बुक) का नियमित संधारण कार्यालय प्रमुख / प्रधानाचार्य का एक अनिवार्य वैधानिक दायित्व है। सेवा पुस्तिका में कर्मचारी की पदस्थापना, वेतन निर्धारण, वार्षिक वेतन वृद्धि, अवकाश लेखा और पदोन्नति का आधिकारिक व प्रमाणित विवरण होता है। इसी अभिलेख के आधार पर सेवानिवृत्ति के समय पेंशन, उपादान (ग्रेच्युटी) और अन्य सेवानिवृत्ति परिलाभों की गणना की जाती है; अतः इसका यथार्थ रख-रखाव आवश्यक है।

questions.question_english: A Principal decides to give a challenging academic project to a teacher, believing the teacher enjoys taking responsibility and is highly creative. The Principal refrains from micromanaging the process. Which theoretical framework is guiding the Principal’s assumption?
options_english: Theory X
Vroom’s Expectancy Theory
Theory Y
Maslow’s Physiological Needs
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (c). Theory Y posits that employees view work as natural, are capable of self-motivation and self-direction, actively seek responsibility, and exhibit ingenuity and creativity in solving organizational problems. By delegating a challenging assignment and granting professional autonomy without micromanagement, the Principal applies the core assumptions of Theory Y.
In contrast, Theory X (option a) would assume workers are lazy and need constant policing. Expectancy Theory (option b) concerns cognitive expectancy calculations, and Maslow's physiological needs (option d) relate strictly to basic physical survival.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (c) है। डगलस मैकग्रेगर का 'सिद्धांत Y' यह मानता है कि कर्मचारी काम को स्वाभाविक मानते हैं, जिम्मेदारी लेना पसंद करते हैं और उनमें उच्च स्तर की रचनात्मकता एवं आंतरिक अभिप्रेरणा होती है। जब कोई प्रधानाचार्य शिक्षक की क्षमताओं पर विश्वास करते हुए उसे बिना अनावश्यक हस्तक्षेप या कड़े नियंत्रण (micromanagement) के चुनौतीपूर्ण कार्य सौंपता है, तो वह 'सिद्धांत Y' के सिद्धांतों का अनुसरण कर रहा होता है।
सिद्धांत X (विकल्प a) कर्मचारियों को अकर्मण्य और अविश्वासी मानता है। अतः विकल्प (c) सही उत्तर है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Theory Y assumes that employees view work as natural, possess intrinsic motivation, seek responsibility, and demonstrate high levels of creativity when properly engaged. By assigning a challenging project without micro-managing, the administrator demonstrates trust in the employee’s self-direction and capabilities. This approach aligns perfectly with Theory Y principles, which emphasize employee empowerment, autonomy, and positive motivational support.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following pairs of motivation theories and their proponents:
I. Two-Factor Theory - Frederick Herzberg
II. Hierarchy of Needs - Abraham Maslow
III. Expectancy Theory - Victor Vroom
IV. Theory X and Theory Y - Douglas McGregor
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
options_english: I and II only
II, III, and IV only
I, III, and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). All four pairs are correctly matched:
I. Frederick Herzberg formulated the Two-Factor Theory (Motivation-Hygiene Theory), identifying intrinsic motivators and extrinsic hygiene factors.
II. Abraham Maslow proposed the Hierarchy of Needs, organizing human needs into five sequential tiers (physiological, safety, social, esteem, and self-actualization).
III. Victor Vroom developed the Expectancy Theory of Motivation, which posits that motivation is a product of Expectancy, Instrumentality, and Valence.
IV. Douglas McGregor conceptualized Theory X and Theory Y, representing authoritarian versus participative management philosophies regarding employee nature.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। चारों युग्म सही सुमेलित हैं:
I. द्वि-कारक सिद्धांत का प्रतिपादन फ्रेडरिक हर्ज़बर्ग ने किया, जिसमें उन्होंने अभिप्रेरक (आंतरिक कारक) और आरोग्य/स्वास्थ्य घटकों (बाह्य कारक) का विश्लेषण किया।
II. आवश्यकताओं के पदानुक्रम सिद्धांत का प्रतिपादन अब्राहम मैस्लो ने किया, जिसमें बुनियादी शारीरिक आवश्यकताओं से लेकर आत्म-सिद्धि तक 5 स्तर शामिल हैं।
III. प्रत्याशा सिद्धांत का प्रतिपादन विक्टर व्रूम ने किया, जिसके अनुसार अभिप्रेरणा = प्रत्याशा (Expectancy) × साधनता (Instrumentality) × संयोजकता (Valence)।

questions.question_english: In modern educational governance, 'Quality Assurance' (QA) fundamentally differs from traditional 'Quality Control' (QC) primarily because QA:

Operates as a reactive monitoring mechanism intended to detect and penalize defects after they occur

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). In contrast, Quality Assurance (QA) is proactive, systematic, and process-oriented. In an educational setting, QA embeds continuous professional development, curricular review, formative peer coaching, and structured pedagogical standards directly into ongoing school processes to prevent learning deficits and operational errors before they materialize.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। गुणवत्ता नियंत्रण (Quality Control - QC) एक प्रतिक्रियात्मक (रिएक्टिव) और अंतिम उत्पाद-आधारित प्रक्रिया है, जो कार्य पूर्ण होने के बाद त्रुटियों की पहचान करती है (जैसे वार्षिक परीक्षा परिणामों में कमियों की जांच)। इसके विपरीत, गुणवत्ता आश्वासन (Quality Assurance - QA) एक अग्रसक्रिय (प्रोएक्टिव) और प्रक्रिया-आधारित उपागम है। शिक्षा के क्षेत्र में यह शिक्षण विधियों, सतत शिक्षक प्रशिक्षण और संस्थागत प्रक्रियाओं में निरंतर सुधार करता है ताकि कमियों और विफलताओं को उत्पन्न होने से पहले ही रोका जा सके।

Consider the following statements regarding Fred Fiedler's Contingency Model of leadership effectiveness:
I. Leadership effectiveness depends fundamentally on a proper match between a leader's inherent orientation and the degree of situational control and favorableness.
II. Fiedler designed the Least Preferred Co-worker (LPC) scale to measure an individual's underlying leadership orientation.
III. A high LPC score designates a task-motivated leader, whereas a low LPC score designates a relationship-motivated leader.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I only
I and II only
II and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (b). In Fred Fiedler's Contingency Theory:
- Statement I is correct: Leadership success is contingent upon matching the leader's fixed behavioral style with the favorableness of the situation (determined by leader-member relations, task structure, and position power).
- Statement II is correct: Fiedler developed the Least Preferred Co-worker (LPC) questionnaire to assess whether a leader is primarily task-oriented or relationship-oriented.
- Statement III is incorrect: The LPC scoring works in reverse of statement III. A person with a high LPC score describes their least preferred co-worker in relatively positive, sympathetic terms, indicating a relationship-oriented leadership style. Conversely, a person with a low LPC score evaluates their least preferred co-worker unfavorably, indicating a task-oriented leadership style. Therefore, only statements I and II are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। फ्रेड फीडलर के आकस्मिकता सिद्धांत के अनुसार:
- कथन I सही है: नेता की प्रभावशीलता इस बात पर निर्भर करती है कि नेता की कार्यशैली और परिस्थिति के अनुकूल होने की डिग्री (नेता-सदस्य संबंध, कार्य संरचना और पद शक्ति) के बीच कितना सामंजस्य है।
- कथन II सही है: नेता की शैली निर्धारित करने के लिए फीडलर ने 'न्यूनतम पसंदीदा सहकर्मी' (LPC) प्रश्नावली विकसित की थी।
- कथन III गलत है: उच्च LPC स्कोर प्राप्त करने वाला व्यक्ति अपने सबसे कम पसंदीदा सहकर्मी का भी सकारात्मक मूल्यांकन करता है, जो 'संबंध-उन्मुख' (relationship-oriented) शैली को दर्शाता है। इसके विपरीत, निम्न LPC स्कोर वाला व्यक्ति 'कार्य-उन्मुख' (task-oriented) शैली को प्रदर्शित करता है।
अतः केवल कथन I और II सही हैं।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Fiedler’s Contingency Theory posits that leadership effectiveness depends on matching a leader’s fixed style with situational favorableness. Fiedler utilized the Least Preferred Co-worker questionnaire to measure leadership orientation. questions.question_english: Which instrument was developed by Halpin and Croft to measure the organizational climate of schools?

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). questions.question_english: Institutional Planning is often described as a milestone in the journey of decentralization in educational management because it:

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). By empowering individual institutions to diagnose their specific contextual challenges, optimize locally available resources, and formulate targeted improvement plans, institutional planning makes educational governance participatory, responsive, and grounded in community realities.
